scene.title: Gradient Descent Walkthrough
scene.summary: A point moves down the slope of a quadratic function by following the negative gradient until it reaches the minimum.

beats.title: Plot and start point
beats.narration: We plot the quadratic f(x) = (x-2)^2 and place a point at x = 4 (f=4).

beats.title: Show gradient
beats.narration: At x = 4 the slope is 4, so the steepest descent points left.

beats.title: First step
beats.narration: Moving opposite the gradient takes the point to x = 3 (f=1).
